external_contracts.source: Native x86-64 LP64, little endian. Syscall entry macros cast unsigned int arguments to32bits, int flags to signed32bit pattern, size_t to64bits.
external_contracts.contract: Contract restricts JSON counts to0..16 and descriptors to signed32 literals or prior nonnegative returns; negative literals become out-of-range unsigned descriptors. No retries.
external_contracts.limitation: No compat ABI, pointer casts beyond allocated buffers, or signal restart semantics.

external_contracts.source: kmalloc, alloc_file_pseudo, file table capacity, IDA.
external_contracts.contract: Normal successful allocation gives fresh object identity. RLIMIT_NOFILE exhaustion is explicitly modeled EMFILE. ENOMEM/ENFILE or failed guest initialization remain separate environment/resource outcomes. IDA failure only yields a negative unobserved fdinfo id.
external_contracts.limitation: No model of slab/file-count pressure, allocation timing, address reuse, or IDA ids.

external_contracts.contract: A live descriptor grants access to one shared file/context object. Temporary and kernel-held references do not equal the number of open FDs. Closing/replacing one alias preserves others. Unreachable historical cells can remain in the model and never become reachable through an old numeric result unless that FD is reused for a newly installed file.
external_contracts.limitation: Reclamation, deferred release, inode refs and numeric reference counts are abstracted.

external_contracts.source: spin locks, irq exclusion, RCU lookup/installation, array_index_nospec.
external_contracts.contract: One trace thread, private FD table, no concurrent eventfd producer or descriptor mutation. Correspondence points retain protected field effects; lock-held source context must be justified separately.
external_contracts.limitation: No concurrency, memory-ordering, speculative execution or RCU lifetime theorem.

external_contracts.source: access_ok, copy_from_user, copy_to_iter and iov_iter initialization.
external_contracts.contract: Every operation receives16allocated bytes; read size0..16 and write exact8 accesses are valid. Bytes are observed in x86-64 little endian. Eventfd's read updates count before its final copy; a future faulting-buffer extension must preserve that order.
external_contracts.limitation: Copy failures excluded by explicit domain. They are not assumed to leave state unchanged.

external_contracts.contract: NONBLOCK always set; no poll/epoll waiters or external signalers exist. Wakeup bookkeeping has no effect on retained counter, descriptor identities or emitted bytes.
external_contracts.limitation: Blocking waits, interruptions, notifications and eventfd_signal_mask paths are outside scope.

external_contracts.source: security_file_fcntl, security_file_permission, fsnotify permission helpers, dnotify, POSIX file locks.
external_contracts.contract: CONFIG_SECURITY=n, CONFIG_FANOTIFY=n and CONFIG_DNOTIFY=n. Trace has no locks or watches. Eventfd has no flush callback. Policy/notification/accounting effects do not change admitted results.
external_contracts.limitation: No other policy configurations, filesystems, locks or notification interfaces.

external_contracts.contract: Context fields are readable/writable, output is writable64bit storage disjoint from context, context waitqueue lock is held and no external interference occurs. eventfd_read holds the lock and passes its separate local ucnt; nonzero guard establishes supported caller case.
external_contracts.limitation: Boolean context witnesses document source obligations; Lean does not prove these facts for machine addresses or C memory.

external_contracts.source: fresh process with descriptors0..7 occupied and RLIMIT_NOFILE32.
external_contracts.contract: Model fdTable contains trace slots only;0..7 are implicit reserved occupants. Initial next_fd8 matches fixture. Kernel default FD capacity64 exceeds allowed bound32. Per-trace reset removes all trace aliases.
external_contracts.limitation: No modeling of fork/runner transport/KCOV fixture setup inside trace semantics.

external_contracts.contract: Mirror allocFd advances cursor and returns a private reservation value; fdInstall commits membership. No supported operation intervenes. Reservation bitmap andCLOEXEC write are folded into installation in the model, an explicit stuttering abstraction.
external_contracts.limitation: No EBUSY from concurrent partially installed descriptors and no theorem over interrupted allocation.

external_contracts.source: Linux raw returns/errno and8byte read output.
external_contracts.contract: Runner emits one ordered observation per operation; stale producer references retain the original FD number, failed producers resolve -1. Trusted comparison owns verdicts.
external_contracts.limitation: Branch labels and KCOV addresses are supporting evidence, never a substitute for result comparison or the source bridge.

operations.testability: differentially testable for valid buffers; review the ordered output assignment and counter subtraction against configured Linux source

domain_partition.syntactically_invalid: Unknown fields, malformed numbers, unsupported op names, invalid refs or reserved descriptor literals are rejected with no execution.
domain_partition.unsupported: Interfaces beyond frozen scope are not generated; explicit proposed extensions retain their own unsupported classification.
domain_partition.environment_resource: Unexpected allocation failure, guest setup failure, lost coverage, timeout or interference never counts as Linux/model agreement.
domain_partition.supported: Every admitted trace remains in evaluator denominator, including semantic mismatch and all failures.

requires C memory and partial-copy/error-state model
requires readiness notifications and external producers
requires scheduling, temporary reservations, RCU and ownership model
